verdict.rationale: Datalab ships a documented public REST API with reference pages for convert, extract, segment, create-document, run-agent, schema generation and health endpoints. It also documents per-request webhooks, a Python SDK and a CLI, and a live llms.txt confirms the docs are agent-readable. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
